ecovacs robotics - deebot t50 pro omni r.description: Meet the DEEBOT T50 PRO OMNI, a powerful robot vacuum and mop designed to deliver more complete cleaning with less daily maintenance. Its 3.19-inch ultra-slim body uses fully embedded dToF LiDAR to reach beneath low furniture, while 15,000Pa suction captures dirt, debris and pet hair from carpets and hard floors. ZeroTangle 2.0 helps minimize hair wrapping around the main brush, and TruEdge 2.0 extends the side brush and mop closer to walls, corners and furniture legs. AIVI 3D 3.0 combines AI-powered vision and structured light with TrueMapping 2.0 to recognize household obstacles, plan efficient routes and clean with fewer interruptions. OZMO Turbo 2.0 uses dual spinning mop pads to scrub stains, while AI stain detection can trigger an additional cleaning pass when needed. Automatic mop lifting helps keep carpets dry, and the 10-in-1 OMNI Station automatically empties dust, washes and dries the mop pads, refills water, dispenses cleaning solution and cleans the station base. Control cleaning through YIKO-GPT, the ECOVACS HOME App, Alexa or Google Assistant.
